page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at 2.55 GHz. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per vCPU. This instance operates on a KVM hypervisor, does not include local storage, and has a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations show strong single-core CPU performance in stress-ng tests, placing in the top 25% of tested hardware. Multi-core CPU performance and PassMark CPU scores fall within the average range. Memory performance is mixed; while the PassMark memory score is strong, large-block uncached memory write bandwidth is weak, landing in the bottom 25%. For specialized tasks, the instance demonstrates strong text generation speeds for small 135M language models, while medium 7B model inference and software compilation tasks yield average performance.

Given its compute-to-memory ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance offers a balanced cost-to-performance profile for compute-heavy workloads that do not require local storage or massive memory footprints. It is well-suited for applications such as web serving, software compilation, database operations, and moderate-scale text processing or small-model LLM inference.
